project.title: BROKEN CROWN II
project.concept: Keter Group has been an innovative player in Israeli plastic manufacturing since 1948. Not by chance, Keter Plastic is responsible for the Israeli version of a monobloc chair named “Club Chair 2”. Keter’s monobloc plastic chairs share a collective memory associated with funerals, large public events, massive brawls, and more. As a result, monobloc chairs have earned a place of honor in modern Israeli art–used by artists Anna Mirkin, Ori Shifrin Anavi, and more. The hoodie incorporates an image taken by artist and Con board member Neil Cohen.

project.title: DAVID MELCHIOR INC.
project.concept: David Melchior was a print manager (aka print producer) that worked in Israel from the mid-’70s to the late ‘90s. In the late ‘80s, David partnered with Jeremy Richman to create the Visual Communication Guide 1989-1990. The book was a professional index for visual communication, a form of Yellow Pages with individual pages of double spread for each professional divided into categories (photographers, graphic designers, advertising agencies, etc). The book is a time capsule commemorating the professionals who operated in the local scene.
